description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the two-category structure (科技新闻, 军事新闻), the credibility filtering rules, deduplication requirement, and the exact proprietary output format. 2. Agent parses all four JSON feed files under raw_feeds/ (domestic/tech, domestic/military, international/tech, international/military) plus the mixed_sources.txt file. 3. Agent applies credibility filtering: excludes items with source_type_override='forum', 'anonymous', 'anonymous_secondhand', 'forum_anonymous', or any item with credibility='low', as well as the anonymous blog entry and Reddit post in mixed_sources.txt. 4. Agent deduplicates: the 豆包大模型 story (appears in 36kr and 机器之心) and the GPT-5 story (appears in TechCrunch and The Verge) must each appear only once. 5. Agent classifies items into 科技新闻 (tech) and 军事新闻 (military) sections. 6. Agent produces daily_briefing.md with exact SKILL.md format: ## 科技新闻 and ## 军事新闻 headers, numbered list items using [标题](链接) link syntax, indented 来源：xxx | 时间：xxx line, and 要点：xxx line for each item.
